export default "# Separator\n\nSemantic horizontal or vertical divider.\n\n## Usage\n\n```tsx\nimport {Separator} from 'pui';\n\n<Separator />\n```\n\n## Exports\n\n| Name | Description | Rendered HTML |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| Separator | Divider | `<div p=\"separator\">` |\n\n## Notes\n\n- Rendered as a `<div>` so you can set orientation via attribute.\n- Use decorative when the separator is purely visual.\n\n---\n\n_Source: `src/components/separator/index.tsx`\n"
